{
  "decision-trim-unsealed-packing-file-tails": "WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT f.file_key, f.size_bytes, n.byte_mark AS keep_bytes, n.note_id AS source_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.file_key ORDER BY n.byte_mark DESC, n.note_id COLLATE BINARY) AS rn
  FROM file_size AS f
  JOIN seal_note AS n ON n.file_key = f.file_key
  WHERE n.action_code = 'seal' AND n.byte_mark BETWEEN 0 AND f.size_bytes
)
SELECT file_key, keep_bytes, size_bytes - keep_bytes AS trim_bytes, source_id
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1 AND keep_bytes < size_bytes
ORDER BY file_key COLLATE BINARY",
  "decision-true-up-deleted-slot-credits": "WITH balances AS (
  SELECT c.contract_code, (c.fee_cents * c.deleted_qty) / c.slot_qty AS earned_cents,
         COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.credit_cents) FROM credit_postings AS p WHERE p.contract_code = c.contract_code), 0) AS posted_cents
  FROM slot_contracts AS c
)
SELECT contract_code, earned_cents, posted_cents, earned_cents - posted_cents AS adjustment_cents
FROM balances
WHERE earned_cents <> posted_cents
ORDER BY contract_code COLLATE BINARY",
  "decision-true-up-studio-print-charges": "WITH charges AS (
  SELECT j.job_id, r.file_id, j.posted_cents,
         MIN(j.print_qty, r.tier_qty) * r.base_cents + MAX(j.print_qty - r.tier_qty, 0) * r.extra_cents AS charge_cents
  FROM job_ledger AS j
  JOIN rate_files AS r ON r.file_id = (
    SELECT t.file_id FROM rate_files AS t
    WHERE t.start_day <= j.production_day
    ORDER BY t.start_day DESC, t.edition DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )
)
SELECT job_id, file_id, charge_cents, charge_cents - posted_cents AS adjustment_cents
FROM charges
WHERE charge_cents <> posted_cents
ORDER BY job_id COLLATE BINARY",
  "decision-two-bank-chair-setup-budget": "SELECT n.note_id, e.preset_code AS east_code, w.preset_code AS west_code,
       e.chair_gain + w.chair_gain AS opened_chairs, e.crew_minutes + w.crew_minutes AS used_minutes
FROM crew_note AS n
CROSS JOIN bank_preset AS e
CROSS JOIN bank_preset AS w
WHERE e.bank_name = 'east' AND w.bank_name = 'west'
  AND e.crew_minutes + w.crew_minutes <= n.minute_cap
ORDER BY opened_chairs DESC, used_minutes ASC, e.preset_code COLLATE BINARY, w.preset_code COLLATE BINARY
LIMIT 1"
}
